research_rationale: Page 1 and complete held OCR read. The operative declaration excepts the Snare and Triest Benning Road viaduct activity from Eight Hour Law for the period of the War; its separate proviso requires time-and-a-half overtime compensation. The page establishes neither actual completion nor first cessation. No date assigned. Minor OCR errors (Other/WVilson/te/W'ar) do not alter these commands; bytes preserved.
savings_reason: Explicit pay proviso preserves compensation as a condition of relief. No held Eight Hour Law original or ending instrument resolves prospective versus accrued rights.

savings_check: Overtime rights could accrue if qualifying work occurred; no assertion that any accrued, were paid, were extinguished, or survive at cutoff. Ending future exemption alone does not discharge them.

research_rationale: Original page 1 identifies EO3391 dated January 27, 1921, amending EO3206 by adding Federal Power Commission, Air Service of the Army, and Naval Aviation. Frozen OCR contains intrusive marks within the command and misreads the dateline as 37 January; materially corrupt text blocks submission. Read complete held EO4547, EO7262 and EO9094 text files as leads. EO4547 adds other agencies, not an ending. EO7262 restates the parent and retains corresponding agencies; amendment is not first cessation. EO9094 section 1 abolishes the same Board, a substantive ending candidate, not automatically the first ending. Raw actor witnesses are not verified held by dispatch.
savings_reason: No express savings in EO3391. EO9094 sections 2-3 transfer functions to Budget Director; functional continuation is not continuation of the abolished membership command. Need verified actor originals and parent text before closing scope/savings.
